expressions.title: Ministry of Finance Notification No. F. 7(14)-CDNS|57, dated 23 May 1959 (amending the Post Office Annuities Rules, 1957)

title_correction.from_title: PNA- Amenmdnets in the Post Office Annuities Rules, 1957
title_correction.basis: The 1957 Rules are the amended parent, not the date of this instrument. Gazette27May1959 prints Ministry of Finance NOTIFICATION, Karachi23May1959, No.F.7(14)-CDNS|57, with six amendments and three attached premium tables. Descriptive title identifies this notification rather than falsely relabelling it as the1957principal Rules.

expressions.title_basis: Printed Ministry of Finance, NOTIFICATION, number and dateline identify the amending notification. The six amendments and TablesI–III are one instrument. No separate principal Rules or inserted Rule13-A expression is created.

source_anomalies.printed: Tables I to II and III
source_anomalies.note: Amendment1 visibly prints to between I and II. Keep the source wording, even though amendment6 lists Tables I,IIandIII.
The separator before57 appears as a vertical stroke in the print; retained as | rather than silently modernizing the identifier.

source_anomalies.note: TableII header grammar retained as printed. The fifteen year columns and75premium amounts are source data, not generated financial calculations.
TableIII six deferment groups each have Annually/Half-yearly/Quarterly columns. Retain72premium amounts and18ellipsis cells; empty cells do not mean zero and are not interpolated.
